items.material:
整理便签
I am going to put the vase on the shelf. Don’t put it near the window.

items.material:
交接卡
These books are for my daughter. I am going to give them to her. Don’t send them to my father.
The map is for my mother.
items.prompt: 伙伴准备寄books给father。按卡片应怎样纠正？只写A/B/C：A books计划给daughter，不能寄father；B books已交给daughter；C books计划给mother。

items.material:
新交接卡
These pictures are for my mother. I am going to show them to her. Don’t take them to my daughter.
The book is for my father.
items.prompt: 伙伴准备带pictures给daughter。按卡片应怎样纠正？只写A/B/C：A pictures已给mother；B pictures计划给father；C pictures计划给mother看，不能带给daughter。

items.material:
换位留言
Ben: Are you going to put the box on the table?
Jo: No. I am going to put it in the cupboard. Don’t put the cups in it.
items.prompt: 已明确it指box。哪条接手信息符合最新留言？只写A/B/C：A box计划放橱柜；cups不能放进box；B box计划放桌子；C cups已放进橱柜。

items.material:
物品分流卡

items.prompt: 只负责map的伙伴应该收到哪条计划？只写A/B/C：A 寄map给father；B 给sister看map，不能寄它；C map已给sister。

items.prompt: 口头说2句：告诉伙伴袋中已核实的物品及单位，再问袋里有没有tea。不要把未知说成没有。

items.material: 野餐分工：你已经检查盒子，里面有一条bread。另一个bag由伙伴负责；其中是否有cheese未检查。
